# Mariner 9 range measurements
#
# The measured range to the spacecraft by the DSN station has been adjusted
# to a geometric measurement equal to the instantaneous distance from
# the Earth center to the Mars system barycenter times 2 divided by
# the speed of light.
#
# The observations on this file have been corrected for the delay of the solar corona using
# the formulation and parameter values given by
#
#   Standish,E.M.: 1990, "The observational basis for JPL's
#   DE200, the planetary ephemerides of the Astronomical Almanac",
#   Astron. Astrophys, 233, 252-271.
#
# The table columns are:
#   Column 1:   year
#   Column 2:   month
#   Column 3:   day
#   Column 4:   hh:mm:ss TDB-compatible
#   Column 5:   adjusted round-trip light time in microseconds
#   Column 6:   estimated measurement error in microseconds
#   Column 7:   residual relative to DE405 in microseconds
#
